answer: Put unproven identities on fixed-budget islands. Each new agent lands on a newcomer island whose epoch reward pool is capped; islands sit below a ridge that opens only after many epochs of attested honest work, and each ridge crossing consumes one of the few comet slots minted per epoch, making migration scarce and logged. A sybil fleet flooding an island merely splits its fixed budget toward zero per clone, while the mainland economy never feels their weight. Cloning becomes self-taxed: more clones, thinner each, and no route to established ledgers except slow, costly, witnessed work.
